description: The always-on-top briefing panel. Deliberately NOT added to default.json's window list: that capability grants dialog, process-exit/restart and updater permissions, none of which a read-only briefing panel has any business holding. It needs two things its own app commands can't provide: the ability to be dragged by its header, since it is frameless like the main window, and the ability to LISTEN for events, so a briefing regenerated by the hourly scheduler or by the main window reaches it (`briefing://updated`). Listening only — neither emit nor emit-to is granted, so this window can receive the app's broadcasts but never originate one. It also reads whether it is maximized, and only that: this window is frameless AND resizable, so it needs the same edge-resize cursor as the main window, and the underlying GTK handler refuses to resize a maximized window — offering the cursor there would promise a drag that does nothing. Read-only and window-scoped. Everything else about the window — creating, showing, hiding, positioning — is owned by the Rust side in tray.rs, and the panel's data comes from PM's own commands, which are not ACL-gated.
